nodes.title: Positive Prompt
widgets_values:
A cinematic, high-detail photorealistic shot of an industrial cyberpunk mecha standing on a neutral background. The giant robot is a completely worn-down, scavenged machine that appears barely held together; its unstable structure is visibly reinforced by an internal, volatile white-blue energy that shines brightly through small cracks, fractured plates, and open mechanical gaps. The chassis is a masterclass in gritty realism, constructed from highly distinguishable scrap: a rusted, crushed semi-truck grill forms the massive chest piece, while heavily dented car doors and twisted engine blocks are bolted onto the shoulders to form a broad, distinct Korean-style mecha silhouette. Every surface is caked in thick, realistic layers of desert dust, engine grime, and blistering oxidation.

The arm configuration is entirely mechanical and weaponized; both upper arms mount directly forward from the shoulders, bypassing forearms or hands entirely to connect instantly into a singular, colossal energy blaster structure that dominates the front of the mecha.

Extending from the back is a propulsion system consisting of two single, straight, narrow metal beams. Each beam acts as a standalone thruster, projecting a massive, powerful down-thrust of white-blue energy that expands outward to form the actual, glowing "wing-like" shape. Intense, high-contrast studio lighting catches the granular texture of the rust and dirt, while casting sharp reflections off the exposed metallic edges. Sharp focus, deep depth of field, 8k resolution, photorealism style.
